what: Observation: the error review of the failed study-isolation job (fresh context per study, pin Hermes) blamed job size. The records show a different first cause: the producer's first command, a read-only compound lookup (git log | head; grep ...), was denied by the command policy, and the contract's rule 6 ('when a tool call is denied ... stop and report it') made it stop with no change, twice. The size check built from that diagnosis was then rejected for not even matching the job.
why: The diagnosis missed the denial in the producer's own invocation record (policy_denials). A fix for size will not stop this recurring: harmless read-only commands get denied and the stop-on-denial rule ends the job. Reporting it for Athena's loop; not fixing it by hand.
